name: noticeboard-threshold-3
description: ⛔ 09/09/2026: NO SUBJECT UNDER THE SHIPPED GAME, AND NOT SINCE 04/09/2026. rules.economy.noticeBoardThreshold is read only by overlays/v31-card-visit.overlay.json: under the meeple loop the Notice Board stopped being a building, and under the commons a central board has no threshold at all (C4). Run this arm alone and it changes nothing. ⚠️ IT IS NOT THE COMMONS CAP. The knob that can cap a central pile is rules.economy.commonsThreshold (overlays/commons-threshold-2.overlay.json), and it is a different rule: a full central board shuts one of five boards to EVERYBODY, and any player may empty it with a Harvest. THE DOOR'S THRESHOLD AT 3, AGAINST THE SHIPPED 2 (v31, 02/09/2026). One knob now, not ten: starters are single-faced, so the printed value is one path per card and the ruling lives in rules.economy.noticeBoardThreshold as an override that the v31 sheet finally agrees with. THIS IS THE ONE LEVER EVER MEASURED TO MOVE THE SUIT BALANCE. On the older two-building surface it was monotone across three paired n=1580 arms: t=4 gave Orchard 80.8%, t=3 62.8%, t=2 42.0%, against an even share of 36.4%. On the single-door surface at n=500: t=5 clogged 2.3% of turn boundaries (no brake at all), t=3 5%, t=2 11%, with the suit spread most even at 2. NONE OF THOSE ARMS CARRIES INTO v31 UNCHANGED, and the reason is new traffic: the same board now absorbs SELF-VISITS as well as rivals', because a seat may place its bonus card on its own Notice Board. At 2 the clog is the only brake on that solitaire door, and it bites in two placements; at 3 the brake is a third weaker and a seat can feed its own board two turns running before shutting itself out. So this arm is not really about visitor throughput any more - it is about how long a seat can play solitaire before the rule stops it. READ IT IN THIS ORDER: (1) the bonus mix, four ways, with visit-yourself counted SEPARATELY from visit-a-neighbour - if the self-visit share rises at 3, the brake is what was holding the hook up and the shipped 2 is doing exactly its job; (2) the suit spread; (3) the door clog rate; (4) denial at 2 seats, where a clogged board is total denial rather than a race. THE THIRD CANDIDATE IS 4, and it is unarmed and not refuted: Dean's argument for it is that a tile costs 4 cards, so a door at 4 holds exactly one delivery's worth of freight. If 3 looks better than 2, run 4 before adopting anything. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved. ⛔ DELIVERY MEEPLE PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the delivery meeple ON as the shipped default (rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace 1, meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction', meepleSpendPerTurn 1, meepleSpendDistinctColours false) together with two new island rules, the space choice (rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice true: a delivery names either free space) and the closing draw (rules.turn.closingDrawPerCrate 1: filling a tile draws one card per crate). This overlay predates it, so all six leaves are pinned here BY NAME at their pre-ruling values (deliveryMeepleSpace null, meepleSpendTiming 'start', meepleSpendPerTurn null, meepleSpendDistinctColours false, deliverySpaceChoice false, closingDrawPerCrate 0; 'start' and null are the old inert values, not 'none' and 0) and it still replays its own game. Since 16/09/2026 the balloons, the Aerodrome, the Village Store, the closing draw and the wild substitution are deleted from the engine, so this overlay no longer replays the game it was recorded on. Its pins for the balloons and the Aerodrome, the Village Store and the closing draw were removed with them. ⚠️ 16/09/2026, THE TOKEN ISLAND AND THE TURN-ORDER RULINGS: the island is now two tokens per tile (Dean, R3: a first delivery pays both demands and chooses its token, a second pays the last token plus 2 any; Workers sit on the 3 and 4 VP tokens), and the Vegetable and Dairy boards were retexted (R9, R10), so this overlay's pins of rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice, rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace were removed with the delivery spaces. It pins rules.economy.noticeBoardPower.vegetableWildCards 0 and dairyDiscount 0 by name, and island.tokens.workerOnVp [] because its game had no island meeple, and it now starts with seat 0 and gives one more turn each (rules.setup.firstPlayer 'seat0', rules.endGame.endOfGame 'oneMoreTurnEach'). It no longer replays the game it was recorded on, and nothing measured before 16/09/2026 is comparable as a level.
